additive_aggregation.description: Multiple fields provide directed, graded evidence whose normalized weighted sum determines the intervention level.

conjunctive_gating.description: Intervention escalates only when multiple necessary conditions jointly satisfy their gates; a missing critical condition limits escalation.

disjunctive_sufficiency.description: Any one sufficiently strong field can independently provide enough evidence to justify escalation.

lexicographic_priority.description: Fields are evaluated in a fixed priority order, and decisive higher-priority evidence cannot be overridden by lower-priority fields.
